core_result: Proves Conjecture 7.7 (conj:atriangle) of Banic & Elezovic (arXiv:2610.17046v1, confirmed open in arXiv:2611.14735v1) via an exact 2D-to-1D combinatorial telescoping reduction, sharp non-asymptotic Stirling bounds, and cubic odd-Gaussian Euler-Maclaurin summation, establishing b_0 = 32*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), b_1 = b_2 = -22*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), d_0 = -4*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, and gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi), rendering linear gamma(n), cyclic gamma_c(n) (n >= 5), and degenerate small-bin gamma(3;N) and gamma(4;N) (Corollary 1.2(i)-(iii)) unconditional.
